comment:
* Lists all the object identifiers of the X509 extensions of the PKIX profile. * *

Extensions are addiitonal attributes which can be inserted in a X509 * v3 certificate. For example a "Driving License Certificate" could have * the driving license number as a extension. * *

Extensions are represented as a sequence of the extension identifier * (Object Identifier), a boolean flag stating whether the extension is to * be treated as being critical and the extension value itself (this is again * a DER encoding of the extension value). * * @see Extension * * * @author Amit Kapoor * @author Hemma Prafullchandra

variables.name: AuthorityKey_data
variables.comment: The object identifiers

variables.name: AuthorityKey_Id
variables.comment: * Identifies the particular public key used to sign the certificate.

variables.name: SubjectKey_Id
variables.comment: * Identifies the particular public key used in an application.

variables.name: KeyUsage_Id
variables.comment: * Defines the purpose of the key contained in the certificate.

variables.name: PrivateKeyUsage_Id
variables.comment:
* Allows the certificate issuer to specify a different validity period
     * for the private key than the certificate.

variables.name: CertificatePolicies_Id
variables.comment: * Contains the sequence of policy information terms.

variables.name: PolicyMappings_Id
variables.comment:
* Lists pairs of objectidentifiers of policies considered equivalent by the
     * issuing CA to the subject CA.

variables.name: SubjectAlternativeName_Id
variables.comment: * Allows additional identities to be bound to the subject of the certificate.

variables.name: IssuerAlternativeName_Id
variables.comment: * Allows additional identities to be associated with the certificate issuer.

variables.name: SubjectDirectoryAttributes_Id
variables.comment:
* Identifies additional directory attributes.
     * This extension is always non-critical.

variables.name: BasicConstraints_Id
variables.comment:
* Identifies whether the subject of the certificate is a CA and how deep
     * a certification path may exist through that CA.

variables.name: NameConstraints_Id
variables.comment:
* Provides for permitted and excluded subtrees that place restrictions
     * on names that may be included within a certificate issued by a given CA.

variables.name: PolicyConstraints_Id
variables.comment:
* Used to either prohibit policy mapping or limit the set of policies
     * that can be in subsequent certificates.

variables.name: CRLDistributionPoints_Id
variables.comment: * Identifies how CRL information is obtained.

variables.name: CRLNumber_Id
variables.comment:
* Conveys a monotonically increasing sequence number for each CRL
     * issued by a given CA.

variables.name: IssuingDistributionPoint_Id
variables.comment: * Identifies the CRL distribution point for a particular CRL.

variables.name: DeltaCRLIndicator_Id
variables.comment: * Identifies the delta CRL.

variables.name: ReasonCode_Id
variables.comment: * Identifies the reason for the certificate revocation.

variables.name: HoldInstructionCode_Id
variables.comment:
* This extension provides a registered instruction identifier indicating
     * the action to be taken, after encountering a certificate that has been
     * placed on hold.

variables.name: InvalidityDate_Id
variables.comment:
* Identifies the date on which it is known or suspected that the private
     * key was compromised or that the certificate otherwise became invalid.

variables.name: ExtendedKeyUsage_Id
variables.comment:
* Identifies one or more purposes for which the certified public key
     * may be used, in addition to or in place of the basic purposes
     * indicated in the key usage extension field.

variables.name: InhibitAnyPolicy_Id
variables.comment: * Specifies whether any-policy policy OID is permitted

variables.name: CertificateIssuer_Id
variables.comment:
* Identifies the certificate issuer associated with an entry in an
     * indirect CRL.

variables.name: AuthInfoAccess_Id
variables.comment:
* This extension indicates how to access CA information and services for
     * the issuer of the certificate in which the extension appears.
     * This information may be used for on-line certification validation
     * services.

variables.name: SubjectInfoAccess_Id
variables.comment:
* This extension indicates how to access CA information and services for
     * the subject of the certificate in which the extension appears.

variables.name: FreshestCRL_Id
variables.comment: * Identifies how delta CRL information is obtained.

variables.name: OCSPNoCheck_Id
variables.comment:
* Identifies the OCSP client can trust the responder for the
     * lifetime of the responder's certificate.
